story: An icon of the skies, the Wrinkled Hornbill (Rhabdotorrhinus corrugatus) is a species from the Bucerotidae family. It thrives in lowland evergreen forest; coastal swamp forest; selectively logged forest, where it interacts with its environment in unique ways. With a conservation status of Endangered (EN), the Wrinkled Hornbill is a focus for conservationists worldwide. Understanding the needs of the Wrinkled Hornbill helps us better comprehend the challenges facing our planet's wildlife.
